locations.name: Moonmart
locations.description: A little convenience store at Bellwether's edge. Its lights stay on for people who need somewhere to rest.

locations.name: The Back Room
locations.description: A small, orderly storeroom with delivery crates, a hand trolley, and shelves that Miso has claimed as a nap route.

locations.name: The Hidden Midnight Room
locations.description: A quiet room tucked into the wall behind Moonmart. The doorway opens only for people who remember why the shop stays lit.

locations.name: Old Bellwether
locations.description: A quiet town centre of brick lanes, a bakery, a bookshop, a post office, and neighbours who remember more than they say.

locations.name: Whisperwood
locations.description: An ancient wood where paths shift gently and the old grove listens for birdsong.

locations.name: Moonwater Harbour
locations.description: A small harbour where the tide leaves impossible things on the wet sand and a boat sometimes arrives without a crew.

locations.name: The Old Lighthouse
locations.description: A decommissioned beacon whose beam still finds the lost, even when its lamp is dark.

locations.name: The Midnight Platform
locations.description: A station between places. Every name in its ledger belongs to someone the world nearly forgot.

locations.name: Moonmart Tea Corner
locations.description: A softly furnished side room for trying teas, sharing a quiet cup, and sitting without any expectation to stay.

locations.name: Moonmart Reading Nook
locations.description: A quiet book-lined room for longer conversations, small gatherings, and a pause between errands.

locations.name: Moonmart Enchanted Greenhouse
locations.description: A moonlit glasshouse where magical plants and ingredients can be tended and studied.
